instruction: Transfer the Bills emails from Thunderbird into a 'emails' directory on Google Drive, naming each .eml file after its subject line.

metadata.explanation: Verifies files in 'emails' folder have .eml extension and at least 2 files exist. Verified Bills folder has 2 emails with subjects containing 'Amazon Web Services' and from X/Twitter.

Metadata mentions specific email subjects ('Amazon Web Services', 'X/Twitter') but evaluator doesn't check if filenames match these subjects
The metric check_filename_pattern__a2f23245 only validates structural properties (.eml extension, min 2 files) but not semantic naming requirements

llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add expected filenames list based on actual email subjects from Bills folder (e.g., ['Amazon Web Services Invoice.eml', 'X Twitter Notification.eml'])
Modify metric to check if retrieved filenames match or contain expected subject line patterns
